title: Paxos leader election storm versus network partition
tell: Leader elections spike while request volume stays flat. Load-driven incidents move both together.
Elections lead the user-visible errors by a minute or two, because replicas lose leases before clients notice failures.
Latency degrades before error rate does: requests queue behind an absent leader before they fail outright.

confusable_with.discriminator: Under a partition, heartbeat_rtt p50 stays normal while p99 does not, because most packets are unaffected and a subset is black-holed. In an election storm both percentiles stay normal and the elections themselves are the anomaly.
A crash loop shows restarts climbing alongside elections. Elections rising with flat restarts points at lease expiry rather than processes dying.
